mapper.sql: id, kind, look_key, names::text AS names, definition::text AS definition, thumbnail_url, sort_order, status, starts_at, ends_at, source, license_note, version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO camera_looks (id, kind, look_key, names, definition, thumbnail_url, sort_order, status, starts_at, ends_at, source, license_note, version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{lookKey}, #{names}::jsonb, #{definition}::jsonb, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{source}, #{licenseNote}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE camera_looks SET names = #{names}::jsonb, definition = #{definition}::jsonb, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, source = #{source}, license_note = #{licenseNote}, version = #{version}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM camera_looks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (starts_at IS NULL OR starts_at <= #{now}) AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > #{now}) ORDER BY kind ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
